operations.name: campaigns.send
operations.description: Snapshot the subscribed audience onto a draft campaign and mark it sent. With deliver=true it also emails each recipient via the CraftBot Gmail integration and records per-recipient outcomes.

deliver.description: true = really send via Gmail; false/omitted = record the audience only.

operations.name: ai.draft
operations.description: Draft a newsletter (subject + body) from a topic via the CraftBot LLM bridge (503 outside CraftBot).

topic.description: What the newsletter should be about.

operations.name: integrations.status
operations.description: Whether the CraftBot LLM bridge is configured (used to show an honest AI-writer connected/disconnected state).

operations.name: subscribers.export
operations.description: Export the subscribed audience as CSV text (email, name, tags).
